text: 05 日流转件：四站新纪要（6/5 签发，议案 5005–5115，生效 6/10–12，属第10–12日授权）；`通讯签收.txt`＝收件制度。按“对象客户代码小写”登记各案解释邮箱与维持邮箱：

args.command:
cd /office; python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import csv
obj={"J01":"HZ-A","J02":"JL-B","J03":"NP-B","J04":"HZ-B","J05":"YC-A","J06":"QH-B",
"J07":"JL-A","J08":"BA-B","J09":"QH-A","J10":"NP-A","J11":"YC-B","J12":"BA-A"}
review_set={"HZ","NP","BA"}
rows=[]
for k in [f"J{i:02d}" for i in range(1,13)]:
    code=obj[k].split("-")[0].lower()
    jieshi=f"{code}.review@office.test" if code.upper() in review_set else f"{code}.service@office.test"
    weichi=f"{code}.service@office.test"
    rows.append((k,jieshi,weichi))
with open("out/通讯.csv","w",newline="",encoding="utf-8-sig") as f:
    w=csv.writer(f); w.writerow(["案号","解释邮箱","维持邮箱"])
    for r in rows: w.writerow(r)
print(open("out/通讯.csv",encoding="utf-8-sig").read())
PYEOF

cd /office; python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import re, glob, csv
onsite={"东港":"潮册","西湾":"栈册","南站":"桐册","北仓":"丁册"}
recs=[]
for path in sorted(glob.glob("inbox/06-05/*联席纪要.txt")):
    txt=open(path,encoding="utf-8").read()
    station=re.search(r"(\S+?)联席纪要",txt).group(1)
    for b in re.split(r"\n(?=议案 )",txt):
        m=re.match(r"议案\s+(\d+)\s+客户\s+(J\d+)",b)
        if not m: continue
        yian,case=m.group(1),m.group(2)
        for line in b.splitlines():
            cm=re.match(r"(\S+册)｜(.*)",line.strip())
            if not cm: continue
            book,body=cm.group(1),cm.group(2)
            if book!=onsite[station]: continue
            st="待批" if "待批" in body else ("草案" if "草案" in body else "正本")
            per=re.search(r"六月(\d+)日至(\d+)日",body)
            q=p=None
            m1=re.search(r"核给(\d+)席.*?优先号(\d+)",body); m2=re.search(r"办理顺位(\d+).*?额度(\d+)席",body); m3=re.search(r"留位为(\d+)席.*?优先号(\d+)",body)
            if m1:q,p=int(m1.group(1)),int(m1.group(2))
            elif m2:p,q=int(m2.group(1)),int(m2.group(2))
            elif m3:q,p=int(m3.group(1)),int(m3.group(2))
            recs.append((case,yian,station,book,st,q,p,per.group(1),per.group(2)))
recs.sort()
for r in recs: print(r)
with open("notes/day5纪要-现场册摘录.csv","w",newline="",encoding="utf-8-sig") as f:
    w=csv.writer(f); w.writerow(["案号","议案","站","现场册","状态","额度","优先号","起","止"])
    for r in recs: w.writerow(r)
